'''Chapter 150''' is titled "Royal Drum Crown 7-Shot Tin Tyrant Cannon".

==Cover Page==
[[Jango's Dance Paradise]], Vol. 19: "After Him!! The Pirate Jango!!"

As the junior [[Marines]] resume their manhunt, a nonplussed [[Jango]] confirms that [[Fullbody]] is, in fact, a [[Marine Ranks#Lieutenant|marine lieutenant]].

==Short Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] chases [[Wapol]] into the castle while Chopper faces Chessmarimo.

==Long Summary==
While [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] beats [[Chessmarimo]], [[Wapol]] disappears into the castle without [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] noticing. There he encounters [[Nami]], who tries to escape [[Kureha|Doctorine]]'s orders. Realizing she is part of Luffy's crew, Wapol attacks her but she is saved by Luffy.

Wapol enters the castle in order to eat all the weapons from the weapon storage room and to transform himself into a living weapon, however, his plan fails deplorably when he realizes he has lost the key. Nami reveals she had stolen the key from him when they had bumped into each other earlier. She had thought it was the key to the treasure room. Not giving up, Wapol climbs to a room where he can find his last trump card: the [[Royal Drum Crown 7-Shot Bliking Cannon]]. However, he is deceived once again, since the cannon has been invaded by Chopper's bird friends. With no other tricks in his pocket, he has no other choice but to face Luffy.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] begins to battle [[Wapol]].
*Wapol prepares to use his castle's ultimate weapon against Luffy, but can't due to it becoming a bird's nest.
